summary: LivePerson Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing receipt of final foreign investment clearance from Bulgarian authorities for its acquisition by SoundHound AI Inc. The deal structure involves two sequential mergers: Merger Sub I merges into LivePerson, making it an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of SoundHound, then Merger Sub II merges into LivePerson. Terms (price per share, premium) are not stated in this filing. Conditions remaining include LivePerson stockholder approval. Regulatory clearances were also obtained from Italy, Canada, Germany, and the UK. Watch for stockholder vote and any unanticipated objections.
